Routine import reinspection by the USDA flagged Listeria in Italian pork guanciale imported by Prime Line and Ferrarini, triggering a multi-state recall.

The Bright Side:
Rigorous border and market testing caught the pathogen before any consumer illnesses were reported.

Regulatory bodies executed transparent intervention, prioritizing public safety over corporate concealment. Importers faced accountability via mandatory recalls.
